questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The academic opportunities of the university and in particular the field of economics, which the university excelled at (such as public economics and behavioral economics)

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Very difficult. All information appeared to be scattered across several different locations online, and most of the practical information were given by former students (who I was lucky to know) rather than from official KU sources.

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Difficult. Would recommend asking former students how they found accomodation.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That it is expensive, but can be done through sites like AirBNB.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Courses filled up quickly, but at UC Berkeley, registrations do not have to be finalized until one month into the semester, which greatly helps.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Register for courses as soon as registration opens.

questions.answer: Fourth year BA corresponding to first year MA in DK. Course level was comparable to KU.
